retraction.withdrawn_claim: five mechanisms remain below mechanism-wide grade
retraction.why: that label was a scope expansion, not a measured finding: the reviews and the closures show every reachable obligation in the OpenSSH consumer closure covered, and the residual items were evidence-coverage notes plus one external ABI contract. No memory-safety defect was demonstrated for any of the five at the OpenSSH scope. The label must not be cited as a safety finding. Retracting the label does not establish the five mechanisms; the adjudication and the freeze record them as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

the recorded instrument runs cover focused subsets rather than every operation in the closure
the five mechanisms are NOT_ESTABLISHED at mechanism-wide grade

external_abi_contract.obligation: a foreign provider may publish a function pointer whose actual type does not match its declared function id
external_abi_contract.crate_enforcement: OsslDispatch fields are crate-private and every production read goes through function_for::<T>/function_ptr_for, which re-check the entry's own id and refuse OSSL_DISPATCH_END and NULL; twenty-one caller-side transmutes were removed; a compile_fail doctest proves external safe construction is impossible
external_abi_contract.classification: external ABI contract under AGENTS.md section 7 criterion 2: the id-to-type pairing is enforced wherever the crate controls both sides, and the remaining exposure is a provider that misdeclares its own table
